patch_resolves_note: The staged patch.diff is the real mach0 list-of-lists fix. It changes the effective copy length at the vulnerable `r_buf_read_at(..., &entry, ...)` site from raw `entsize` to bounded `mines`, and the fixed assertion trace reaches the protected sink with the bounded length.

nodes.description: The selected sink is the prefill `memset (buf, 0xff, count)` in `io_memory_read`, reached for the same stack destination pointer and effective read length issued by `iterate_list_of_lists`.
nodes.evidence: The vulnerable assertion trace reaches `io_memory_prefill` after `list_entry_read`, and the same trace shows that sink event consuming the forwarded entry pointer and read length.

edges.description: The effective length argument used at `r_buf_read_at (bf->buf, r, (ut8*)&entry, ...)` is forwarded unchanged through the I/O stack as `count` into `io_memory_read`.
The destination pointer `(ut8*)&entry` passed at the vulnerable call site becomes the `buf` argument consumed by the sink prefill in `io_memory_read`.

root_cause_criterion.description: At `r_buf_read_at (bf->buf, r, (ut8*)&entry, entsize)`, the effective read length used for the stack destination must not exceed `sizeof (entry)`. The vulnerable program passes the attacker-controlled length directly; the fixed code passes only the bounded length.
root_cause_criterion.verification_note: The vulnerable assertion trace violates the predicate (`11 <= 8` is false) while the fixed assertion trace reaches the same protected sink with the bounded read length (`8 <= 8` is true).
